}}'''Feral Villagers''' are the [[Feral Parasites|Feral Version]] of Villagers.
==''Spawning''==
* Spawned when a Villager is killed by a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]].
* Spawns from a Villager succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onwards.
* Spawns when an [[Assimilated Villager]] accumulates a killcount of 60 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 25, once 6 Villagers have been assimilated.

==''Behavior''==
Feral Villagers are Melee Combatants.
* Feral Villagers attack through contact damage.
* Feral Villagers can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Feral Villagers are able to sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On hit, Feral Villagers has a chance to drop [[Remains|Feral Remains]].

===''Weaknesses''===
* Feral Villagers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Feral Villagers have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Feral Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* On death, Feral VIllagers have a chance to drop a [[Gnat]].
